blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two leaders of the House of Representatives have appeared lukewarm toward a push to recall the 2027 budget bill recently passed by the chamber, saying any issues can be addressed at the bicameral conference committee. At a press briefing on Monday, Deputy Speaker Ronaldo Puno and Bataan Rep. Albert Garcia said they believe the Supreme Court (SC) ruling declaring provisions in the 2024, 2025 and 2026 budgets unconstitutional will not affect the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 budget, or the General Appropriations Bill (GAB) under House Bill No. 10858.
